title: Meri tamanna ye hai
body:
bole shabbir ke bas meri tammana ye hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kiska laasha hai jo tukdo bata hai logon
khaake karbal ne kaha qasim e naushah ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe akbar ko uthate huwe kehte hai hussain
nee ko darkar jo hota hai kaleja ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
fatema zehra ke bachon par bahao aansu
khuld mein jaane ka aasaan tareekha ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuld mein leke jo aaye ye janabe zehra
dekho allah mere asghar ka shalooka ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq pe jaan waar ke islam bachaya jis ne
haan ye dil bande nabi syed e zeeshan ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan ne nazron se jo qaatil ka jigar chaak kare
ghazi abbas e jari saani e hyder ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakhri sajda jo sarwar ne kiya reti par
faqr karte huwe rab ne kaha banda ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunke quran ki tilawat jo dekha raahib ne
haa ye naize pe buland kaari e quran ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
haan ye darbar e yazeedi ne suna jab khutba
nabeena kehne laga hyder e safdar ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye mujhe mil gaya mazhar ko lab e kausar par
apne ashkon ke ewaz maine khareeda ye hai
bole shabbir ke bas...
author: Mazhar Abidi
